content.text: Relax a/v smooth musc->↓PVR (afterload=a., preload=v.) & a. BP
Min chng in CO, renal blood flow, GFR
1st dose syncope: BB can help counter
COX-1: constitutive (housekeeping, all tissues) → synth cytoprotective PG (GI)
COX-2: inducible enzyme → rapid ↑when inflam prod
CNS: HA, tinnitus, dizzy      -   renal/hepatic tox: AKF if vol deplete
renal: PGE2/PGI2 maintain renal blood flow → ↓PG → ↑Na/H2O →
edema -> ↓antiHTN meds & ↑AKI (esp CKD, HF, cirrhosis, vol deplete) -unopposed vasoconstrict
GI bleed/ulcer, dyspepsia → take w food
cardiac: ↑CV thrombotic risk -> avoid chronic if CVD hx
preg: avoid ±20wk -> fetal renal dysfun, oligohydramnios
Pt ed: take w food: ↓GI effects
↑serious CV thrombotic events (MI, stroke) -poss fatal (↑if CVD or RF)
-poss fatal (↑risk: age, corticosteroids, anticoag, ulcer hx, ↑dose)
Indications: used mainly for anti-inflammatory effects as first line agents for relief of sxs in chronic inflammatory disease states

: GI (irritation, gastritis, PUD, bleeding), increased bleeding time, decreased GFR, ischemia, acute renal failure, salt/water retention, CHF risk, rash, SJS, asthmatics (bronchospasm, dyspnea, wheezing), aseptic meningitis, exacerbation of anemia, rebound HA
Class: prototype strong μ-r agonist            -major analgesic in crude opium
Admin: PO, IV, rectal, SC, intrathecal, SL
Met: least lipophilic (little crosses BBB) BUT cross placenta → ⍉use in labor
morphine-3-glucuronide (neuroexcite → accum → neurotox, myoclonus, delirium, sz; ↑risk renal insuff)
Class: synthetic, related to meperidine                  *100× morphine potency
Admin: parenteral (IV, epidural, intrathecal), oral transmucus, SL, buccal, IN, transdermal
transdermal: delayed onset & offset     ***⍉start in opioid-naive***
patch releases drug hrs after removal
Pt ed: ⍉share - keep out of reach of others
Hyperosmolar urine: ↑ [urine]: ex used in hyper K
Renal failure, gout, pulm edema,  HF, DM, Hyperlipidemia
Metabolized-excreated via kidney & GI -> less toxicity for renal failure pt
